title: Don't Patronize Me! An Annotated Dataset with Patronizing and Condescending Language towards Vulnerable Communities
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on identifying and categorizing 'Patronizing and Condescending Language (PCL) towards vulnerable communities'. This is framed as a form of harmful language that can 'routinize discrimination' and lead to 'greater exclusion and inequalities'. The entire work is motivated by the ethical concern of mitigating harmful speech and its negative societal impacts, making it a study centered on the ethics of language use.
